summary: OceanPal Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, reporting the completed sale of 100% of OP Vessel Holdco LLC to Sezali Inc. on July 31, 2026. Consideration comprised cancellation of all 12,185 Series C Preferred shares and $5.0 million promissory notes; no cash or common stock changed hands. The transaction was approved by independent disinterested directors due to Sezali's affiliation with the former Chairperson. OceanPal exits shipping, retains only SovereignAI and a NEAR digital asset treasury. Watch for further debt or preferred retirements and alignment with crypto asset performance.
